scope_note: Covers what constitutes the Scottish Administration as defined by section 126 of the Scotland Act 1998, and how the list of non-ministerial offices within it is completed by subordinate legislation, both Orders in Council under section 126(8)(b) and Orders under section 104. Limited to legislation.

steps.title: Retrieve the definition itself
steps.detail: Retrieve section 126 of the Scotland Act 1998 and set out what the Scottish Administration consists of and how office-holders and staff are defined.

steps.title: Identify the offices named on the face of the Act
steps.detail: Identify the non-ministerial offices listed expressly in section 126(8)(a).

steps.title: Establish how the remaining offices are added
steps.detail: Establish the mechanism by which further non-ministerial offices are brought within the Scottish Administration, and retrieve examples of instruments exercising it.

steps.title: Find bodies made part of the Scottish Administration by section 104 Orders
steps.detail: Identify Orders made under section 104 of the Scotland Act 1998 that declare a body to be part of the Scottish Administration, which are not Orders in Council under section 126(8)(b), and list the bodies they name.

steps.title: Assess whether a complete list is obtainable
steps.detail: Determine whether a complete enumeration can be produced from primary legislation alone, and say so plainly if it cannot.
